The Chansey Chase | POKÉTOON Short
Meg is spending the next week with her uncle, who lives in a house inside a lush Safari Zone filled with wild Pokémon. There, she encounters a mysterious Chansey wearing a hat. No one has been able to catch the Chansey, and even more strangely, her uncle seems to already know it somehow! Curious about the connection between Chansey and her uncle, Meg decides to set out and explore the Safari Zone on her own.
